newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Investors plan $100 mln Kuwait finance firm - paper.
newsitem.headline: Investors plan $100 mln Kuwait finance firm - paper.

text.p: A Group of Arab, European and American investors plan to create a $100 million finance firm, a newspaper reported on Tuesday.

"An agreement has been reached among a group of financial institutions and (business) families and individuals from Kuwait, (other) Arab states, the United States and Europe to create an international investment firm" al-Syeassah newspaper quoted Kuwaiti businessman Abdul-Salam al-Awadi as saying.
Awadi said the Kuwait-based 30 million dinars ($100 million) firm will be called "Gulfinvest".
"The main objective of the company is to provide investment opportunities for foreign firms in Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) states and (other) Arab states," said Awadi.
The GCC political and economic alliance groups Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrian, Oman, the United Arab Emirate and Qatar.
